xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4563: Replay-backed protocol tests for codex app-server and ACP transports

plan.title: Replay-backed protocol tests for codex app-server and ACP transports
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Codex app-server and ACP transports are tested only against hand-written mocks, so provider ordering changes (idle status vs turn completion, interrupt response vs interrupted state, sub-agent completion before the parent, mid-turn approval/user-input requests) leave tests green while the dashboard breaks. Reading the code also shows two defects: Codex state cannot report an interrupted turn (D-1), and user-input answers are sent in a non-schema shape (D-2).
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/protocol-capture/: a scrubbed JSONL fixture format, a capture sink enabled by OVERDECK_PROTOCOL_CAPTURE_DIR (Codex via an AppServerTransport wrapper in the manager, ACP via protocolLogging raw events from host main), a replay engine that plays fixtures to the real client code with id rewriting and strict client-frame matching, and a recorder script that drives the real hosts through named scenarios. Record five Codex fixtures and two Kimi ACP fixtures and write replay tests asserting manager/host state and the ACP transcript. Fix D-1 (lastTurnStatus) and D-2 (answer shape). Document recording and replay in docs/PROTOCOL-REPLAY-TESTS.md. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4563.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Deduplicating or changing the two acp-mock-peer.ts files
- Replaying the Codex native Unix-socket (WebSocket) transport
- An ACP sub-agent or ACP approval replay case
- An OpenCode ACP fixture
- Regenerating or committing a new app-server-schema.json
- Any dashboard UI change, including showing lastTurnStatus in the frontend
- Enabling capture for any production launch or exposing it in settings or the CLI
- Changing packages/effect-acp
- Hand-written fixtures, except the single documented synthetic user-input fallback

autoDecisions.summary: Kimi is the ACP agent recorded for the ACP cases
autoDecisions.rationale: The acp harness defaults its provider to kimi (src/lib/runtimes/acp.ts:77) and harness policy denies non-Kimi models on acp, so Kimi is the production ACP path.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex replay replaces only the child process via the existing spawnProcess and readVersion options; no new manager option
autoDecisions.rationale: It runs the real stdio NDJSON framing and needs no production change; the native socket carries the same JSON, so it is a non-goal.

autoDecisions.summary: ACP capture uses protocolLogging raw events passed from host main(); ACP replay provides a ChildProcessSpawner
autoDecisions.rationale: protocolLogging already passes through makeKimiAcpRuntime/makeOpenCodeAcpRuntime, and the spawner seam already has a working in-memory pattern in session-runtime.test.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Scrub at capture time with five fixed rules, plus a hygiene test over committed fixtures
autoDecisions.rationale: Raw secrets never reach disk, and the hygiene test is a mechanical backstop against push-protection failures and personal-data leaks.

autoDecisions.summary: Add lastTurnStatus to Codex manager state and host status() (D-1)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires asserting interrupted state, and Overdeck currently has no field that records it; one state field and one status line is the smallest honest fix.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the user-input answer shape in this PR (D-2) and land it before the user-input recording
autoDecisions.rationale: The schema requires { answers: string[] } per question; recording with the old shape would capture a rejected answer.

autoDecisions.summary: The only synthetic fixture allowed is Codex user-input, flagged in its header with a follow-up issue
autoDecisions.rationale: default_mode_request_user_input is 'under development' in codex 0.159.0 and user input was not offered in default mode on 0.153.4, so a live recording may be impossible; every other case must be live.

autoDecisions.summary: Defects found by the new tests are fixed in this PR when the fix stays inside planned files and is at most 40 changed lines; otherwise filed and pinned
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies the issue's 'fixed or filed' criterion with a mechanical rule instead of a judgment call.

autoDecisions.summary: Recorder lives in src/lib/protocol-capture/record.ts and runs via node --import tsx
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the plan within the projected-surface limits and matches the existing main-guard pattern in codex and ACP host modules; it uses persistent app-server/acp sessions, not one-shot execs.

Build the fixture replay engine with id rewriting, matching, and breakpoints

expected_outputs: replay.test.ts passes all eleven behavior tests
metadata.parallelSafeReason: It creates only new files (replay.ts and its test) that no concurrently ready item touches.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-7: src/lib/protocol-capture/replay.ts exporting ReplayMatcher, ReplayMismatchError, ProtocolReplay, and createProtocolReplay(fixture, { schedule }). Deliver in frames one per setImmediate tick, block at out frames until a matching client line arrives, queue early client lines, rewrite recorded client-request ids in responses to live ids, keep server-request ids, compare client responses by id and deep-equal result, treat out frames after the last in frame as an optional tail, support pauseBefore/awaitingClient/resume (both reject at once when no frame from the cursor onward matches) and unmatchedClientLines. Write the eleven named behavior tests from WI-7 with fixtures built inside the test.

items.title: Given a recorded response to client request id 3 and a live client that used id "a7", the engine delivers the response with id "a7" while server-request ids are delivered unchanged
When the client sends a different method than the recorded out frame, done rejects with ReplayMismatchError whose message contains the frame seq, the expected method, and the actual line
Given a client line that arrives before its recorded position, the engine queues it and matches it when the cursor reaches that out frame
Given pauseBefore(matcher), delivery stops before the first matching in frame until resume(), and done resolves even when a trailing out notification after the last in frame never arrives
replay.test.ts contains and passes all eleven behaviors listed in PRD WI-7, including pauseBefore/awaitingClient rejecting at once when no later frame matches

metadata.parallelSafeReason: It creates only record.ts, a new file no other item edits; it imports finished modules read-only.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-10: src/lib/protocol-capture/record.ts runnable as node --import tsx src/lib/protocol-capture/record.ts --harness <codex|acp> --scenario <name> --out <path> [--model] [--effort], with defaults gpt-5.6-luna/low for Codex and k3 for Kimi.
